description:
Order a decorated cake delivered to a company, paid from your wallet. Send an idempotencyKey of at most 200 characters.
Use for: a cake for a company address. The wallet is charged before the vendor gets the order. The same idempotencyKey answers for the first order as it now stands, ignores new input, and never charges twice.
Not for: adding money to your wallet (fund_wallet).
Needs: an API key. Hosted sign-in cannot call this yet.
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: send_cake({"recipient":{"company":"Acme Robotics","contactName":"Ada Lovelace","address":"1 Market St","address2":"Floor 4","city":"San Francisco","state":"CA","zip":"94105"},"cakeSize":"8in","design":{"messageText":"Congrats on the launch!"},"cardMessage":"From your friends at Northwind","idempotencyKey":"5f0c7a2e-8d4b-4e1a-9c3f-2b6d1e8a7f40"})
Key: the idempotencyKey in the example is a sample. Replace it with a new unique key for each new call, and keep that key for the call’s retries and any confirmation it asks for.
Repeat: A repeat with the same input, and the same key if you sent one, does not act twice: it returns the same result, finishes the first call, or is refused.
Errors: wallet_short, spending_limit_reached, not_deliverable, order_unavailable, design_too_large, order_refused, account_setup_required, internal_error; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

cardMessage.description: A card that goes with the cake.

design.description: Exactly one of messageText, imageSvg, imageUrl or imageBase64. A large image goes by imageUrl.

imageBase64.description: a string at most 8000000 character(s) long

imageSvg.description: a string at most 2000000 character(s) long

idempotencyKey.description: A unique string for this call. Repeat it when you retry, so the call runs once.

metadata.description: Your own labels, up to 28 keys, passed to the vendor.

propertyNames.description: a string at most 100 character(s) long

recipient.description: A company. Send websiteUrl, or all of address, city, state and zip.

address.description: a string at most 500 character(s) long

city.description: a string at most 200 character(s) long

company.description: a string at most 300 character(s) long

state.description: a string at most 100 character(s) long

websiteUrl.description: The company's website, instead of an address.

zip.description: a string at most 20 character(s) long

name: send_cake

charge.description: Taken from your wallet: price + fee.

status.description: placed: the vendor has the order. pending: charged, the vendor has not confirmed it yet; do not send it again with a new key. delivered. delivery_failed: the charge is being returned. refunded: delivery failed and the charge is back in your wallet.

title: Send a cake
